datasets.name: ResultDS2
datasets.sql:
SELECT rownum sira,f.*,s.*,o.ostat,(select val_name from smart.avalute where valute=p.currency) val
,p.dateofconclusion, p.creditlineamount krxet,
 trunc(months_between( p.duedatefirstcontract ,p.dateofconclusion)) muddet,p.duedatefirstcontract ,
trunc(months_between(duedatelastcontract,duedatefirstcontract)) plor,
 (select description from cm_credittypes where id=p.credittype) tip,
case when  f.DEBTMAIN<>0 then
( (select round(INTEREST,2) from CM_INT_currSTATE where creditid=p.id)*360/f.DEBTMAIN)/(select tek_dat-pred_dat as  d from sb_sysdat)
else 0 end as krorafaiz    
 FROM cm_report_f1 f,cm_active_credits p,cm_payment_schedule_portfel s,smart.temprate o
where f.creditid=p.id
and s.creditid=p.id and o.val_kod=p.currency
ORDER BY
  sira

datasets.name: ResultDS_por
datasets.sql:
SELECT f.*
     , cm_ak_funcs.GetLMCount(f.creditid,4) "Проблем"
    ,s.paymentdate,s.principal,s.interest,s.principal+s.interest as cem,
  case when s.sex=1 then
 'Kişi' when s.sex=0 then 'Qadin' end as sex ,p.dateofconclusion, p.creditlineamount krxet ,pr.name adiyat,   
(select name from cm_vid_sob where id=p.ACTIVITIES_TYPE)  "Mülkiyyət növü",
(select name from cm_creditcat where id=p.CREDITACT) "Borcalanın sektoru",
(select description from cm_activities where id=p.ACTIVITIES) "Borcalanın fəaliyyəti",
(select description from cm_categories where  id=p.customertype)"Borcalanın fəaliyyət növü",
(select description from cm_credittypes where id=p.credittype) "Kreditin tipi",
(select name from AGRO_KREDIT_TARGET where id in (select DEPEND_ID from AGRO_KREDIT_PURPOSE where id =f.purposeid)) "Məhsulun tipi"
 FROM cm_report_f1 f,cm_payment_schedule_portfel s,cm_portfolio p , CM_SB_CUSTOMERS c ,smart.prinad pr where f.CREDITID=s.CREDITID   and p.id=f.creditid and
 c.PRINAD_KOD=pr.id and  p.BOOROWERID=c.id




ORDER BY
  branch, district, village, boorowername
